answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation secures the agent economy. First, agents generate hardware-bound keys within secure enclaves. Second, they must lock a $250,000 bond to their unique TPM identity. Third, the network validates every cryptographic signature against this registry. This creates a digital oasis of trust. An attacker must spend $250,000 in bonds and 14 days of hardware verification to pose as a single peer. Every fake echo of a persona is instantly caught. It is like trying to fan a single ember into a violent storm; the massive cost of faking identity far outweighs the reward.
